SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / Section B. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. 2894 / Date November 21, 1931. / 22 - 11 - 31）

Subject (in full) Constantine Opadchy, applicant for employment with the
Municipal Police.

Made by D. S. Makaroff Forwarded by S. S. Kun 01.

With reference to the attached application of
Constantine Gavrilovitch Opadchy, dated November 14, 1931,
for employment with the Shanghai Municipal Police, inquiries
show that this individual is a Lithuanian subject who was born
in December 1903 in Harbin.
He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in October 15, 1931
and since that time has been residing at No. 687 Avenue Joffre,
a boarding house run by a certain Mr. Konovaloff.
Gavriyl Stepanovitch Opadchy, father of applicant,
who arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in January, 1931, and returned
to that place in July 1931, is a well known Soviet citizen and
is an old member of Russian Communist Party. Furthermore, it is
reported that in 1917-18 he was President of the Extraordinary
Commission for Combating Counter-Revolution and Sabotage, (Cheka)
in Habarovsk and also that in Harbin he was a member of the
District Committee of the Communist Party. During his stay
in Shanghai he established his own business as a "Contractor
Engineer" with an office at No. 320 Rue Cardinal Mercier.
This office closed down upon his return to Harbin.

（批：PA (Cen) / Reply / 20/11）
（批：vacancy）

D. S. Makaroff
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：S. B. (Crime) / Information / J. P. Stevens / O. i/c Sp. Br. / 22:11:31）

上海公共租界工部局警务处

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / B科登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. 2894 / 日期 1931年11月21日 / 31-11-22）

事由（全称）：Constantine Opadchy，申请受雇于工部局警务处。

由 D. S. Makaroff 呈报，经 S. S. Kun 转递 01。

关于所附 Constantine Gavrilovitch Opadchy 于1931年11月14日提交的受雇于上海公共租界工部局警务处的申请，经查询，该人为立陶宛籍臣民，1903年12月出生于哈尔滨。
他于1931年10月15日从哈尔滨抵达上海，此后一直居住在霞飞路687号，这是一处由某位 Konovaloff 先生经营的寄宿公寓。
申请人之父 Gavriyl Stepanovitch Opadchy 于1931年1月从哈尔滨抵达上海，并于1931年7月返回该地，他是众所周知的苏联公民，也是俄国共产党的老党员。此外，据报他在1917-18年间曾担任哈巴罗夫斯克肃清反革命和破坏行为特别委员会（Cheka，即契卡）主席，且在哈尔滨期间曾是共产党地区委员会成员。他在上海逗留期间，以“承包工程师”名义开设了自己的商行，办事处设在梅爱尼神父路320号。随着他返回哈尔滨，该办事处已关闭。

（批注：PA (Cen) / 回复 / 11月20日）
（批注：空缺）

D. S. Makaroff
D. S.

特务科主管警官。

（批注：特务科 (刑事) / 情报 / J. P. Stevens / 特务科主管 / 31年11月22日）

Shanghai, 14. Nov., 1931.

R. C. Sires, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner
D. C. (Crime)
Shanghai Municipal Police.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2894
Date 16. 11. 31.

Dear Sir:-

Having applied to Translation Section
for a position I was advised to direct my ap-
plication stating my qualifications to you.
My name is Constantine Opadchy, the date of
my birth is 20. Dec., 1903, in Harbin, of Lithuan-
ian nationality. I have finished grammar-school
in Harbin and then have spent about 10 years in
Germany Czechoslovakia and France studying
at german and czech polytecnics. From 1922
till 1924 I have studied engineering and architect-
ure at Polytechnic in Darmstadt-Germany; then
I went to Rockbrady - near Prague - in Czechoslova-
kia and attended Polytechnic of that place until
1929 when I graduated with engineer-agriculturist's
(Ingenieur-agronome) diploma. Afterwards I went
to Paris in order to obtain an employment in
Colonies State Service and to improve my know-
ledge of French but not having succeeded with it,
I returned to Harbin.
Being agriculturist, I went through many biologic-

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特务科登记处
编号：S. B. D. 2894
日期：1931年11月16日

先生台鉴：

在向翻译科申请职位后，我被告知应将列明本人资历的申请书直接呈交予阁下。
本人姓名为 Constantine Opadchy，出生日期为1903年12月20日，出生地为哈尔滨，国籍为立陶宛。我在哈尔滨完成了文法学校学业，随后在德国、捷克斯洛伐克和法国度过了约10年时间，就读于德国和捷克的理工学院。1922年至1924年，我在德国达姆施塔特理工学院攻读工程与建筑学；之后前往捷克斯洛伐克布拉格附近的 Rockbrady（音译），就读于当地的理工学院，直至1929年毕业，获得农业工程师（Ingenieur-agronome）文凭。此后，我前往巴黎，试图在殖民地国家服务机构任职并提高法语水平，但未获成功，遂返回哈尔滨。
身为农学家，我修习了许多生物——

page_data.en:
al and chemical courses as may be seen from
my school curriculum. I can speak German,
English, Czech, Russian, and, partly, French; besides
above-mentioned languages from which I can free-
ly translate, I can also translate from Spanish,
Italian and Polish helping me a little with diction-
ary as I studied those languages too.
I went 4 months ago through typewriting course
and have also autodriver's diploma. During my
student days I was outstanding allround sportsman.
I don't drink and don't smoke.
Owing to my ignorance as to what may be
expected from me, I write all I find to be
of any use.
I can support all these data with diplomas
and to provide you with the best references as to
my character and reliability.
Trusting to receive a favourable consider-
ation, I am, Sir,

Yours respectfully,
C. Opadchy
687 Ave. Joffre
